Authorship is not decidable from a path; the guarantee is carried by the pre-handover run plus the freeze receipt. Fixed, and recorded in the protocol as the sharpest argument against using a checkout as the surface.

RESUME_RULE: Annex A.6 refusal rule. Recompute the plan fingerprint with governance/scripts/governance_fingerprint.py compose --role plan before resuming; never compare against a value copied from prose. Recompute the candidate hash with candidate_content_hash.py --base cbce3016 --tip <content tip> before treating any recorded value as current.
